evals.name: learn-skill-creator-rationale
evals.prompt: I want to learn the rationale behind the skill-creator skill. I'm a developer who uses Claude Code daily and I'm curious about why the skill system was designed the way it is. I have about 5-8 hours per week to dedicate to this learning project. Help me create a goal record for this.
evals.expected_output: A timestamped goal-record file with four sections (Overall Goal, Current Level Baseline, Learning Habits and Unit Capacity, Staged Task List) and an entry in revise-note.md. The scope should be appropriately sized for 5-8 hours/week of learning.

assertions.name: has-four-required-sections
assertions.description: Goal record must have all four required sections

assertions.name: has-timestamped-filename
assertions.description: Output file must follow naming convention goal-record-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.md

assertions.name: asks-questions-one-at-a-time
assertions.description: Skill should ask questions one at a time during clarification, not dump all questions at once

assertions.name: asks-file-preference-before-writing
assertions.description: Before writing files, skill must ask whether to create new file or modify existing
assertions.must_contain: create a new timestamped goal-record file

assertions.name: confirms-information-before-proceeding
assertions.description: After gathering information, skill should confirm it has enough before moving to next step

assertions.name: files-created-before-session-end
assertions.description: Both goal-record and revise-note files must exist at end of session

evals.name: revise-delete-stages
evals.prompt: I have an existing goal record with multiple stages. After reviewing it, I realize the last stage is not aligned with my actual goal - it's about applying what I learn, but I just want to understand the topic, not necessarily apply it. Can you help me revise my goal record to delete the last stage?
evals.expected_output: A modified goal-record file (or new timestamped version based on user choice) with the last stage removed. Plus a revise-note.md entry explaining what was deleted and why.

assertions.name: asks-new-or-modify-file
assertions.description: Skill must ask whether to create new file or modify existing one before writing

assertions.name: reads-existing-goal-record
assertions.description: Skill should read the existing goal-record file first to understand current structure

assertions.name: revise-note-explains-deletion-why
assertions.description: Revise note should explain why the stages were deleted

assertions.name: revise-note-lists-deleted-stages
assertions.description: Revise note should list which stages were removed

assertions.name: has-fewer-stages
assertions.description: Updated goal should have one fewer stage than the original

assertions.name: files-created-before-session-end
assertions.description: Both goal-record and revise-note files must exist at end of session
